title: QBIND Public DevNet Operator Public Identity
description: Canonical operator-facing schema for the PUBLIC identity document emitted by the Run 374 identity-generation helper (`run_374_public_devnet_identity_generation_helper generate`). DevNet only: experimental, resettable, no value, no MainNet readiness claim, no C4/C5 closure claim. This document carries only PUBLIC material (NodeId, fingerprints, root id/public key, suite ids, and the ready-to-copy --p2p-trusted-root spec). It MUST NOT contain any secret key, KEM secret, signing secret, mnemonic, or credential. A document that validates against this schema is NOT a public DevNet launch claim.

schema_version.description: Version of this operator-identity schema/document format.

environment.description: Deployment environment. DevNet only for this document.

role.description: Identity role this material was generated for.

suite.description: PQC suite identifiers for the signature (root -> leaf delegation) and the leaf KEM.

node_id.description: Full NodeId as 64 lowercase hex chars. Derived deterministically as sha3_256('QBIND:nodeid:v1' || leaf_kem_pk). Safe to publish.

node_id_short.description: First 8 bytes of the NodeId as 16 lowercase hex chars (log/display form). Safe to publish.

peer_id.description: P2P peer identity. For the KEMTLS transport identity this equals node_id. Safe to publish.

leaf_cert_fingerprint.description: SHA3-256 fingerprint of the canonical leaf NetworkDelegationCert bytes, 64 lowercase hex chars. Safe to publish.

leaf_cert_fingerprint_short.description: First 4 bytes of the leaf cert fingerprint as 8 lowercase hex chars (log/display form). Safe to publish.

root_key_id.description: Trust-root key id (32 bytes) as 64 lowercase hex chars, embedded in every leaf cert issued by this root. Safe to publish.

root_pk_fingerprint.description: First 4 bytes of SHA3-256(root_pk) as 8 lowercase hex chars (log-safe fingerprint of the root public key). Safe to publish.

trusted_root_spec.description: Ready-to-copy value for the pre-existing --p2p-trusted-root flag: '<root_key_id_hex>:<suite_id>:<root_pk_hex>'. Contains only PUBLIC root material. Safe to publish.

validator_address.description: Public validator address for a validator-candidate identity, or null for full-node/seed roles.

transport_security_mode.description: Transport security posture the material is intended for, e.g. 'kemtls-mutual-auth-required'.

pqc_suite.description: PQC suite identifier for seed-list interop, e.g. 'ml-dsa-44'.

private_material.description: Paths (NOT contents) of the private material generated alongside this public identity. The referenced files MUST NEVER be published or committed.

safety_label.description: Mandatory DevNet safety label. All flags must be present and set as shown.

devnet_only.description: Must be true. Marks the identity as DevNet-only, no-value, resettable material.

allOf.description: Only a validator-candidate may carry a non-null validator_address.
